text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The day of the Kikuka-sho. The paddock was 
wrapped in a restless buzz.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
"After making it through a single summer, 
Rice Shower had transformed completely."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Despite whispers of doubt regarding the 
distance... Mihono Bourbon is still widely 
expected to be the race favorite.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And while not drawing much attention, 
Machikane Tannhauser was brimming with 
motivation.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The battle to decide the strongest 
Umamusume, the Kikuka Sho, is about to 
begin...!
